decisions.reason: The necessary refund-rule impact is already represented by the candidate's complete same-message MODIFY, which changes the refund from excess USDC to unused ETH.
The exactOutputSingle decision applies only to the ETH-funded wallet mint and does not change the deferred Transak fiat conversion or mint flow.
The source changes ETH-to-USDC conversion mechanics, not the direct connected-wallet USDC mint flow.
The internal ETH conversion method does not alter which payment methods are disclosed or selectable.
The source does not change Transak-based wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access for fiat buyers.
Changing the ETH swap to exactOutputSingle does not change the condition for displaying successful-mint feedback.
Obtaining exactly 15 USDC from ETH does not change the $15 price or the existing founder, affiliate, and prize-pool allocations.
The conversion algorithm does not alter the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The source does not change the optional tipping controls, placement, presets, or custom-tip behavior.
The source changes an internal ETH conversion implementation and does not necessarily require any change to the current customer-facing FAQ content.
The exactOutputSingle implementation detail does not change any current About-page product, process, technology, or pricing copy.
The ETH swap method does not change NFT metadata attributes, referral identity, viewer links, or wallet metadata display.
